description: This file defines the TagsPage widget for a Flutter application, providing UI and logic for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tags. It primarily manages user interactions with tags, including navigation to form pages and handling tag deletion with confirmation dialogs and cascading updates to related tasks.

classes.name: TagsPage
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays and manages a list of tags with CRUD operations, including navigation and dialogs for editing and deleting tags.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage to create a new tag.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage to edit an existing tag.

methods.name: _showTagMenu
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet menu with options to edit or delete a specific tag.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion of a tag and updates related tasks before deleting the tag itself.
